Part of the analysis code for the matched liver–serum multi-omics study in MASLD. This script is self-contained: open it in RStudio (or `rmarkdown::render("Fig1_hepatic_transcriptome.Rmd")` from this folder). It first loads the workspace of the previous step (`Table1_cohort`), running that script if needed. Input data are read from `data/` (see `data/README.md`); Supplementary Tables used here are in `Source_data/`; Source Data for this item are written to `Source_data/`; other outputs go to `results/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

  while (!file.exists(file.path(d, "common", "setup.R")) && dirname(d) != d) d <- dirname(d)
  d
}
source(file.path(.root, "common", "setup.R"))
```

# Hepatic transcriptome: Fig. 1 and Tables S1-S2b

Liver RNA-seq in 208 participants. DESeq2 (Wald test, apeglm shrinkage) adjusted for age, BMI and sex; genes with >= 10 reads in >= 10 samples; DEGs at FDR <= 0.05; KEGG enrichment of up- and downregulated DEGs at FDR <= 0.10 with >= 3 genes. PCA of the variance-stabilised counts is Fig. S1.

```{r hepatict-01, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
host_liver_rawCounts <- read.table(file.path(project_dir, "Transcriptomics/MAFALDA_STAR/genes.expected_count.txt"), header = T, row.names = 1)
# Load phenotypic data from an Excel file
phenotype <- data.frame(readxl::read_excel(file.path(project_dir, "Analyisis/Metadata.xlsx")))
rownames(phenotype) <- phenotype$id
phenotype <- phenotype[,-1]
# Rename column names to remove trailing "LAT" if present
colnames(host_liver_rawCounts) <- sub("LAT$", "", colnames(host_liver_rawCounts))
# Ensure the column names of host_liver_rawCounts match row names of phenotype
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(host_liver_rawCounts), rownames(phenotype))
# Subset host_liver_rawCounts to include only the common samples
host_liver_rawCounts_subset <- host_liver_rawCounts[, common_samples]
# Reorder phenotype to match the order of columns in host_liver_rawCounts_subset
phenotype_subset <- phenotype[common_samples, ]
# Calculate the total count for each gene across all samples
total_counts_per_gene <- rowSums(host_liver_rawCounts_subset)
# Identify genes that are singletons (total count <= 1)
singleton_genes <- total_counts_per_gene <= 10
# Subset the count data to exclude singleton genes
host_liver_rawCounts_filtered <- host_liver_rawCounts_subset[!singleton_genes, ]
# Check dimensions to ensure they match
dim(host_liver_rawCounts_subset)
dim(host_liver_rawCounts_filtered)
dim(phenotype_subset)
all(colnames(host_liver_rawCounts_filtered) == row.names(phenotype_subset))
# Load DESeq2 library
library(DESeq2)
host_liver_rawCounts_filtered <- round(host_liver_rawCounts_filtered)
# Create DESeq2 object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = host_liver_rawCounts_filtered,
  colData = phenotype_subset,
  design = ~1
)
# Samples left out of the RNA-seq analysis (208 participants remain)
remove_samples <- c("LIVMF239", "LIVMF99")
dds <- dds[, !colnames(dds) %in% remove_samples]
# Check that they were removed
colnames(dds)
dim(dds)
# Run DESeq2
dds <- DESeq(dds)
# Check results names
resultsNames(dds)

```

#### Transcriptomics (N=208)

```{r hepatict-02}
## =====================================================================
## Liver RNA-seq: differential expression -> KEGG enrichment -> Figure 1
##                -> Tables S1, S2a, S2b (+ Fig. S1 PCA)
##
## Needs the DESeq2 object `dds` (208 participants). Outputs go to DEG_208/.
## Model: ~ age (z) + BMI (z) + sex + trait; genes with >= 10 reads in >= 10 samples.
## =====================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(DESeq2); library(apeglm)
    library(clusterProfiler); library(org.Hs.eg.db); library(AnnotationDbi); library(enrichplot)
    library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
    library(cowplot); library(ggvenn); library(EnhancedVolcano); library(openxlsx)
})
OUT <- "DEG_208"; dir.create(OUT, showWarnings = FALSE)
f <- function(x) file.path(OUT, x)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 0. Settings
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
MIN_COUNT  <- 10                          # reads
MIN_SAMPLES <- 10                         # in at least this many samples (21,114 genes)
TRAITS     <- c("Steatosis", "Inflammation", "Fibrosis")
strip_ver <- function(x) sub("\\..*$", "", x)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Samples and genes
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
d0 <- dds                      # 208 participants (two samples already removed with the DESeq2 object)
n_start <- ncol(d0); genes_start <- nrow(d0)
rownames(d0) <- strip_ver(rownames(d0))
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Covariates, phenotypes, expression filter
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
d0$Gender <- factor(d0$Gender_M0F1, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
d0$Age_z  <- as.numeric(scale(d0$Age_yr))
d0$BMI_z  <- as.numeric(scale(d0$BMI_kgm2))
d0$Steatosis    <- factor(ifelse(d0$steatosis_Kleiner    == 0, 0, 1), levels = c(0, 1))
d0$Inflammation <- factor(ifelse(d0$inflammation_Kleiner == 0, 0, 1), levels = c(0, 1))
d0$Fibrosis     <- factor(ifelse(d0$fibrosis_Kleiner_04  == 0, 0, 1), levels = c(0, 1))
keep <- rowSums(counts(d0) >= MIN_COUNT) >= MIN_SAMPLES
d0 <- d0[keep, ]
cat("Samples:", ncol(d0), "| women:", sum(d0$Gender == "Female"),
    "| men:", sum(d0$Gender == "Male"), "| genes kept:", nrow(d0), "of", genes_start, "\n")
sym <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = rownames(d0), keytype = "ENSEMBL",
              column = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first")
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. DEGs (identical model for each trait)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
run_deg <- function(trait) {
    d <- d0
    design(d) <- as.formula(paste("~ Age_z + BMI_z + Gender +", trait))
    d <- DESeq(d, quiet = TRUE)
    cf <- paste0(trait, "_1_vs_0")
    res <- results(d, name = cf, alpha = FDR_GENE)
    shr <- lfcShrink(d, coef = cf, type = "apeglm", res = res, quiet = TRUE)
    shr <- shr[!is.na(shr$padj), ]
    shr$Gene <- unname(sym[rownames(shr)]); shr$Gene[is.na(shr$Gene)] <- ""
    shr
}
res <- setNames(lapply(TRAITS, run_deg), TRAITS)
degs <- lapply(res, function(r) r[r$padj <= FDR_GENE, ])
up   <- lapply(degs, function(r) rownames(r)[r$log2FoldChange > 0])
down <- lapply(degs, function(r) rownames(r)[r$log2FoldChange < 0])
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 4. Enrichment (tested genes as background, BH-FDR ≤ 0.10)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
to_entrez <- function(ens) unique(na.omit(mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = ens, keytype = "ENSEMBL",
                                                 column = "ENTREZID", multiVals = "first")))
universe <- to_entrez(rownames(d0))
fdr_keep <- function(e) { if (!is.null(e)) e@result <- subset(e@result, p.adjust <= FDR_KEGG); e }
go_fun <- function(g) fdr_keep(enrichGO(to_entrez(g), universe = universe, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                                        ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 1,
                                        qvalueCutoff = 1, readable = TRUE))
kegg_fun <- function(g) {
    e <- enrichKEGG(to_entrez(g), universe = universe, organism = "hsa",
                    pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1)
    if (!is.null(e)) e <- setReadable(e, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
    fdr_keep(e)
}
enr <- list()
for (t in TRAITS) for (dir in c("Up", "Down")) {
    g <- if (dir == "Up") up[[t]] else down[[t]]
    enr[[paste(t, dir, "GO", sep = "_")]]   <- if (length(g)) go_fun(g) else NULL
    enr[[paste(t, dir, "KEGG", sep = "_")]] <- if (length(g)) kegg_fun(g) else NULL
}
enr_table <- function(type) bind_rows(lapply(names(enr)[grepl(paste0("_", type, "$"), names(enr))], function(n) {
    e <- enr[[n]]; if (is.null(e) || nrow(e@result) == 0) return(NULL)
    p <- strsplit(n, "_")[[1]]
    mutate(e@result, Phenotype = p[1], Direction = p[2], Type = type)
}))
kegg_all <- enr_table("KEGG"); go_all <- enr_table("GO")
if (nrow(kegg_all)) {
    if (!"category" %in% names(kegg_all)) kegg_all$category <- NA
    kegg_all$category[kegg_all$ID == "hsa04820"] <- "Cellular Processes"
}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 5. Figure 1
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
make_volcano <- function(r, title) {
    col <- ifelse(r$padj <= FDR_GENE & r$log2FoldChange >  1, "#ffa500ff",
                  ifelse(r$padj <= FDR_GENE & r$log2FoldChange < -1, "#4575B4", "grey"))
    names(col) <- ifelse(col == "grey", "NS", ifelse(col == "#4575B4", "Down", "Up"))
    EnhancedVolcano(r, lab = r$Gene, x = "log2FoldChange", y = "padj",
                    ylab = bquote(~-Log[10]~italic(FDR)),
                    pCutoff = FDR_GENE, FCcutoff = 1, colCustom = col,
                    title = title, subtitle = NULL, caption = NULL,
                    labSize = 4, pointSize = 2.5, colAlpha = 0.8,
                    drawConnectors = TRUE, widthConnectors = 0.3, max.overlaps = 15,
                    legendPosition = "none")
}
vol <- lapply(TRAITS, function(t) make_volcano(res[[t]], t))
venn <- function(lst, colr, ttl) ggvenn(lst, fill_color = rep(colr, 3), stroke_size = 0.5,
                                        set_name_size = 5, text_size = 4, show_percentage = FALSE) +
    ggtitle(ttl) + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
                         panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
venn_up   <- venn(up,   "#ffa500ff", "Up-regulated DEGs")
venn_down <- venn(down, "#4575B4",   "Down-regulated DEGs")
kegg_plot_df <- kegg_all %>%
    group_by(Phenotype, Direction) %>% arrange(p.adjust) %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% ungroup() %>%
    filter(Count >= 3) %>%
    mutate(Phenotype = factor(Phenotype, levels = TRAITS),
           Description = factor(Description, levels = unique(Description[order(Direction, p.adjust)])))
kegg_dot <- ggplot(kegg_plot_df, aes(Phenotype, Description, size = -log10(p.adjust), colour = Direction)) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, seed = 1), alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Up = "#ffa500ff", Down = "#4575B4")) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 8)) + scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    labs(size = "-log10(FDR)", colour = "Direction", x = "Phenotype", y = "KEGG Pathway") +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 12, face = "bold"),
          panel.grid = element_blank())
row1   <- plot_grid(plotlist = vol, ncol = 3, align = "h", labels = "a", label_size = 16)
bottom <- plot_grid(plot_grid(venn_up, venn_down, ncol = 1, labels = "b", label_size = 16),
                    ggplotGrob(kegg_dot), ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1, 1.5),
                    labels = c("", "c"), label_size = 16)
fig2 <- plot_grid(row1, bottom, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 1.5)) +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
ggsave(f("Fig1_DEGs.png"),  fig2, width = 19, height = 15, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(f("Fig1_DEGs.tiff"), fig2, width = 19, height = 15, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
ggsave(f("Fig1_DEGs.pdf"),  fig2, width = 19, height = 15, bg = "white")
## Fig. S1: PCA of the variance-stabilised counts (n = 208)
vsd <- vst(d0, blind = TRUE)
pca <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "Gender", returnData = TRUE); pv <- round(100 * attr(pca, "percentVar"))
figS1 <- ggplot(pca, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = Gender)) + geom_point(size = 2) + stat_ellipse() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Male = "#4575B4", Female = "#D73027"), name = "Sex") +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1: ", pv[1], "% variance"), y = paste0("PC2: ", pv[2], "% variance")) + theme_bw()
ggsave(f("FigS1_PCA.png"), figS1, width = 6, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 6. Tables + numbers workbook
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
S3 <- bind_rows(lapply(TRAITS, function(t) {
    r <- degs[[t]]
    data.frame(Ensembl = rownames(r), Symbol = r$Gene, baseMean = r$baseMean,
               log2FoldChange = r$log2FoldChange, lfcSE = r$lfcSE, pvalue = r$pvalue,
               padj = r$padj, Histology = t,
               Direction = ifelse(r$log2FoldChange > 0, "Up", "Down"))
})) %>% arrange(Histology, padj)
S4 <- S3 %>% distinct(Ensembl, Symbol, Direction, Histology) %>% mutate(v = 1L) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Histology, values_from = v, values_fill = 0L) %>%
    mutate(Total_Phenotypes = rowSums(across(any_of(TRAITS))))
summary_tab <- data.frame(
    Trait = TRAITS,
    cases = sapply(TRAITS, function(t) sum(d0[[t]] == 1)),
    controls = sapply(TRAITS, function(t) sum(d0[[t]] == 0)),
    DEGs = sapply(degs, nrow), Up = sapply(up, length), Down = sapply(down, length))
venn_counts <- function(lst, dir) {
    u <- unique(unlist(lst)); m <- sapply(lst, function(x) u %in% x)
    as.data.frame(table(apply(m, 1, function(r) paste(TRAITS[r], collapse = "+")))) |>
        setNames(c("Region", "n")) |> transform(Direction = dir)
}
venn_tab <- rbind(venn_counts(up, "Up"), venn_counts(down, "Down"))
run_info <- data.frame(
    item = c("samples", "women", "men", "genes_before_filter", "genes_after_filter", "filter_rule"),
    value = c(ncol(d0), sum(d0$Gender == "Female"), sum(d0$Gender == "Male"),
              genes_start, nrow(d0), paste0(">=", MIN_COUNT, " reads in >=", MIN_SAMPLES, " samples")))

sheets <- list(run_info = run_info, trait_groups = summary_tab[, 1:3],
               DEG_summary = summary_tab, Venn_counts = venn_tab,
               Table_S1 = S3, Table_S2a = S4, Table_S2b = kegg_all, GO_all = go_all)
sheets <- Filter(Negate(is.null), sheets)
wb <- createWorkbook()
for (n in names(sheets)) { addWorksheet(wb, n); writeData(wb, n, sheets[[n]]) }
saveWorkbook(wb, f("manuscript_numbers_DEG_208.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
print(run_info); print(summary_tab)
cat("\nDone:", f("manuscript_numbers_DEG_208.xlsx"), "and", f("Fig1_DEGs.png"), "\n")
```

## Source Data Fig. 1 and Fig. S1

```{r hepatict-03, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sd1_vol <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(TRAITS, function(t) {
  r <- as.data.frame(res[[t]])
  data.frame(Histology = t, Ensembl_ID = rownames(r), Gene_symbol = r$Gene, baseMean = r$baseMean,
             log2FoldChange = r$log2FoldChange, lfcSE = r$lfcSE, pvalue = r$pvalue, padj = r$padj,
             Status = ifelse(r$padj <= FDR_GENE & r$log2FoldChange > 1, "Up (|log2FC| > 1)",
                      ifelse(r$padj <= FDR_GENE & r$log2FoldChange < -1, "Down (|log2FC| > 1)", "Other")))
}))
venn_mem <- function(lst, dir) data.frame(Ensembl_ID = unique(unlist(lst)), Direction = dir) %>%
  dplyr::bind_cols(as.data.frame(sapply(lst, function(x) as.integer(unique(unlist(lst)) %in% x))))
sd1_venn <- dplyr::bind_rows(venn_mem(up, "Up"), venn_mem(down, "Down"))
sd1_venn$Gene_symbol <- unname(sym[sd1_venn$Ensembl_ID])
write_source_data("Source Data Fig. 1.xlsx", list(
  sd_panel("Fig. 1a", "Volcano plots: all tested genes per histological feature (DESeq2, apeglm-shrunk log2 fold change, BH-adjusted P value).", sd1_vol),
  sd_panel("Fig. 1b", "Overlap of up- and downregulated DEGs (FDR <= 0.05) across the three features (1 = significant).", sd1_venn),
  sd_panel("Fig. 1c", "KEGG pathways plotted (top 10 per feature and direction, >= 3 genes; FDR <= 0.10).",
           as.data.frame(kegg_plot_df) %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c("Phenotype", "Direction", "category", "ID", "Description", "GeneRatio", "BgRatio", "Count", "pvalue", "p.adjust", "qvalue", "geneID"))))))
write_source_data("Source Data Fig. S1.xlsx", list(
  sd_panel("Fig. S1", "PCA of variance-stabilised liver counts (208 participants).", pca)))
```

## Tables S1, S2a and S2b

```{r hepatict-04, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
add_table("Table S1", S3 %>%
  dplyr::transmute(`Ensembl gene ID` = Ensembl, Direction, baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, pvalue, padj, Histology, `Gene symbol` = Symbol))
add_table("Table S2a", S4 %>%
  dplyr::transmute(`Ensembl ID` = Ensembl, Symbol, Steatosis, Inflammation, Fibrosis, Direction, Total_Phenotypes))
k <- kegg_all
for (cl in c("subcategory", "FoldEnrichment")) if (!cl %in% names(k)) k[[cl]] <- NA
add_table("Table S2b", k %>%
  dplyr::select(Phenotype, Direction, category, subcategory, ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio,
                FoldEnrichment, pvalue, p.adjust, qvalue, geneID, Count))

# copies of the discovery results used by the external-validation chunks
disc_res <- res
ekegg_up_fibrosis   <- enr[["Fibrosis_Up_KEGG"]]
ekegg_down_fibrosis <- enr[["Fibrosis_Down_KEGG"]]
```
